# Isaiah Chapter 54 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 17 verses]*

*Sing O barren one; your Maker is your husband; taught by the LORD; no weapon shall prosper*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 54 (The Future Glory of Zion) addresses sing o barren one; your maker is your husband; taught by the lord; no weapon shall prosper. The key verse — "No weapon that is fashioned against you shall succeed" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to Second Isaiah (chs. 40-55), focused on comfort, restoration, and the servant figure.
